scientific_integrity: The result is supported by full enumeration of 32767 nonempty principal submatrices in each of two degree-four finite fields, an independent exact seed determinant identity, and algebraic translation/complement reductions. No claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for the characteristic-seven Fourier matrix of order fifteen. Does not settle principal nonsingularity over the complex numbers for order 105; potential prior unindexed computations remain a literature risk.
title: Exact characteristic-seven principal-minor defects of the order-fifteen Fourier matrix
